description: Explicit semantic re-review ledger for German records whose canonical source changed after the original language review. The historical source snapshot remains in the batch; this ledger binds the current canonical source to the reviewed localized title so later source or localized-copy drift fails the contract.

records.reviewed_localized_title: Suchen Sie gezielt nach belastbaren Informationen, die Ihrer aktuellen Sicht widersprechen könnten

source.title: Run a Disconfirming-Evidence Check
source.subtitle: Test one claim against evidence that could weaken it
source.description: State one claim precisely, define what evidence would make you less confident, inspect relevant credible evidence, and update the decision if the evidence warrants it.

records.reviewed_localized_title: Fragen Sie bei versunkenen Kosten: Würde ich heute mit diesem Wissen erneut weitermachen?

source.title: Judge a Commitment by What Comes Next
source.subtitle: A quick stop, continue, or change check
source.description: When past time, money, or effort is dominating a continuation decision, separate what cannot be recovered and compare realistic future costs, benefits, constraints, and alternatives.

records.reviewed_localized_title: Formulieren Sie für wiederkehrende Situationen einfache Wenn-dann-Regeln

source.title: Turn a Good Intention into an If-Then Plan
source.subtitle: Connect one observable cue to one specific action
source.description: For a goal you already want to pursue, define a concrete cue and a feasible response in the form: If X happens, then I will do Y. Implementation intentions are well supported, but they are a self-regulation aid rather than an automatic behavior guarantee.

records.reviewed_localized_title: Prüfe weitere Informationen, bevor die erste Zahl oder Aussage zum Anker wird

source.title: Pause Before Accepting the First Number or Frame
source.subtitle: A short decision check for first-impression anchors
source.description: Before committing to the first number, option, estimate, or framing you encounter, make it explicit, generate an independent alternative, and check the information that matters to the choice.

records.reviewed_localized_title: Lass vergangene Kosten nicht allein über die Zukunft entscheiden

source.title: Review a High-Commitment Continue-or-Stop Decision
source.subtitle: A structured comparison for commitments that are hard to reassess
source.description: For a commitment with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, or meaningful switching costs, compare future paths explicitly and document which current facts justify the next step.
